        date_trunc('month', strptime(c.beginday, '%d/%m/%Y')) AS start_month,
        count(*) OVER (
            PARTITION BY c.homefirm,
                         date_trunc('month', strptime(c.beginday, '%d/%m/%Y'))
        ) AS monthly_volume
    FROM cases c
    WHERE c.homefirm = 'COGNIZANT TECHNOLOGY SOLUTIONS US CORP'
),
input_cases AS (
    SELECT
        m.*,
        cw.wsstate,
        pw.wage_details -> 'prevailing_wage' ->> 'level' AS wage_level,
        CASE
            WHEN monthly_volume = 1 THEN '1'
            WHEN monthly_volume <= 4 THEN '2-4'
            WHEN monthly_volume <= 14 THEN '5-14'
            ELSE '15+'
        END AS volume_band
    FROM monthly m
    JOIN case_worksite cw ON cw.dockkey = m.filekey
    JOIN prevailing_wage pw ON pw.trackno = cw.wagetrack
    WHERE m.start_month = DATE '2023-12-01'
),
ranked AS (
    SELECT
        i.filekey,
        i.headct,
        r.base_hours,
        r.position_hours,
        row_number() OVER (
            PARTITION BY i.filekey
            ORDER BY
                (r.visa_class IS NOT NULL)::INT
              + (r.wage_level IS NOT NULL)::INT
              + (r.h1b_dependent IS NOT NULL)::INT
              + (r.soc_major_group IS NOT NULL)::INT
              + (r.worksite_state IS NOT NULL)::INT
              + (r.monthly_volume_band IS NOT NULL)::INT DESC,
                r.rule_id ASC
        ) AS rn

    COALESCE(r.position_hours, 0.50) AS position_hours
  FROM case_attributes ca
  LEFT JOIN main.review_schedule r
    ON (r.visa_class IS NULL OR r.visa_class = ca.visa_class)
   AND (r.wage_level IS NULL OR r.wage_level = ca.wage_level)
   AND (r.h1b_dependent IS NULL OR r.h1b_dependent = ca.h1b_dependent)
   AND (r.soc_major_group IS NULL OR r.soc_major_group = ca.soc_major_group)
   AND (r.worksite_state IS NULL OR r.worksite_state = ca.worksite_state)
   AND (r.monthly_volume_band IS NULL OR r.monthly_volume_band = ca.monthly_volume_band)
  QUALIFY row_number() OVER (
    PARTITION BY ca.filekey
    ORDER BY
      (CASE WHEN r.visa_class IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
       + CASE WHEN r.wage_level IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
       + CASE WHEN r.h1b_dependent IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
       + CASE WHEN r.soc_major_group IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
       + CASE WHEN r.worksite_state IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
       + CASE WHEN r.monthly_volume_band IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) DESC,
      r.rule_id ASC
  ) = 1
)
SELECT
  ROUND(AVG(base_hours + position_hours * headct)
    FILTER (WHERE h1b_dependent = 'Yes'), 2) AS avg_yes,
  ROUND(AVG(base_hours + position_hours * headct)
    FILTER (WHERE h1b_dependent = 'No'), 2) AS avg_no
FROM governing
WHERE start_month = DATE '2024-01-01';

            ), ',', '') AS DECIMAL(18, 2)
        ) * CASE json_extract_string(p.wage_details, '$.prevailing_wage.unit')
                WHEN 'Hour' THEN 2080
                WHEN 'Week' THEN 52
                WHEN 'Month' THEN 12
                WHEN 'Year' THEN 1
            END AS annual_prevailing,
        json_extract_string(p.wage_details, '$.prevailing_wage.level') AS wage_level

            ), ',', '') AS DECIMAL(18, 2)
        ) * CASE json_extract_string(p.wage_details, '$.prevailing_wage.unit')
                WHEN 'Hour' THEN 2080
                WHEN 'Week' THEN 52
                WHEN 'Month' THEN 12
                WHEN 'Year' THEN 1
            END AS annual_prevailing,
        json_extract_string(p.wage_details, '$.prevailing_wage.level') AS wage_level
    FROM cases c
    JOIN case_worksite cw ON cw.dockkey = c.filekey
    JOIN prevailing_wage p ON p.trackno = cw.wagetrack
    WHERE substr(c.beginday, 4, 7) = '01/2024'
      AND CAST(c.h1bdep AS VARCHAR) IN ('Yes', 'No')
),
case_scores AS (
    SELECT
        dependency,
        0.7 * 100
            * LEAST(GREATEST(
                (annual_offer - annual_prevailing) / annual_prevailing, 0
              ), 0.40) / 0.40
        + 0.3 * CASE wage_level
                    WHEN 'I' THEN 25
                    WHEN 'II' THEN 50
                    WHEN 'III' THEN 75
                    WHEN 'IV' THEN 100
                    ELSE 50
                END AS cwas
    FROM case_wages
)
SELECT
    ROUND(AVG(cwas) FILTER (WHERE dependency = 'Yes'), 2) AS yes_avg_cwas,
    ROUND(AVG(cwas) FILTER (WHERE dependency = 'No'), 2) AS no_avg_cwas
FROM case_scores;

WITH monthly AS (

  SELECT

    cr.rule_id,
    cr.flat_charge,
    cr.charge_pct,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
      PARTITION BY r.casenum
      ORDER BY
        (CASE WHEN cr.customer_segment IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
         + CASE WHEN cr.return_channel IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
         + CASE WHEN cr.item_category IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
         + CASE WHEN cr.primary_reason IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
         + CASE WHEN cr.item_condition IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
         + CASE WHEN cr.min_monthly_returns IS NOT NULL
                  OR cr.max_monthly_returns IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) DESC,
        cr.rule_id ASC
    ) AS rn
  FROM main.returns r
  JOIN main.orders o ON o.txnnum = r.srctxn
  LEFT JOIN main.customers c ON c.profilenum = o.buyerlink

WITH return_base AS (
    SELECT
        r.casenum,
        r.revdate,
        r.return_channel,
        r.return_details -> 'reasoning' ->> 'primary_reason' AS primary_reason,
        c.seg_category,
        p.itemcategory,
        p.unit_value,
        q.assessment_summary -> 'condition' ->> 'item_condition' AS item_condition,
        COUNT(*) OVER (
            PARTITION BY o.buyerlink, LEFT(r.revdate, 7)
        ) AS monthly_returns
    FROM returns r
    JOIN orders o ON o.txnnum = r.srctxn
    JOIN customers c ON c.profilenum = o.buyerlink
    JOIN products p ON p.itemcode = r.itemlink
    LEFT JOIN quality_assessment q ON q.inspectref = r.casenum
),
charged AS (
    SELECT
        b.revdate,
        b.unit_value,
        COALESCE(m.flat_charge, 15.00) AS flat_charge,
        COALESCE(m.charge_pct, 5.0) AS charge_pct
    FROM return_base b
    LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
        SELECT cr.flat_charge, cr.charge_pct
        FROM return_charge_rules cr
        WHERE (cr.customer_segment IS NULL OR cr.customer_segment = b.seg_category)
          AND (cr.return_channel IS NULL OR cr.return_channel = b.return_channel)
          AND (cr.item_category IS NULL OR cr.item_category = b.itemcategory)
          AND (cr.primary_reason IS NULL OR cr.primary_reason = b.primary_reason)
          AND (cr.item_condition IS NULL OR cr.item_condition = b.item_condition)
          AND (cr.min_monthly_returns IS NULL OR cr.min_monthly_returns <= b.monthly_returns)
          AND (cr.max_monthly_returns IS NULL OR cr.max_monthly_returns >= b.monthly_returns)
        ORDER BY
            (CASE WHEN cr.customer_segment IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
           + CASE WHEN cr.return_channel IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
           + CASE WHEN cr.item_category IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
           + CASE WHEN cr.primary_reason IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
           + CASE WHEN cr.item_condition IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
           + CASE WHEN cr.min_monthly_returns IS NOT NULL
                    OR cr.max_monthly_returns IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) DESC,
            cr.rule_id ASC
        LIMIT 1
    ) m ON true
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS n_returns
FROM charged
WHERE revdate >= '2025-01-01'
  AND revdate < '2026-01-01'
  AND flat_charge + charge_pct / 100.0 * unit_value > 150;

    o.buyerlink AS cust,

),
matched AS (
  SELECT
    r.casenum,
    r.revdate,
    CAST(p.unit_value AS DOUBLE) AS unit_value,
    cr.rule_id,

          + CASE WHEN cr.min_monthly_returns IS NOT NULL

  JOIN main.orders o ON o.txnnum = r.srctxn
  LEFT JOIN main.customers c ON c.profilenum = o.buyerlink

)

        o.buyerlink AS cust,
        substr(r.revdate, 1, 7) AS mon,
        COUNT(*) AS cmrc
    FROM main.returns r
    JOIN main.orders o ON o.txnnum = r.srctxn
    GROUP BY o.buyerlink, substr(r.revdate, 1, 7)
),
matched AS (
    SELECT
        r.casenum,
        p.unit_value,
        cr.rule_id,
        cr.flat_charge,
        cr.charge_pct,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            PARTITION BY r.casenum
            ORDER BY
                (CASE WHEN cr.customer_segment IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
               + CASE WHEN cr.return_channel IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
               + CASE WHEN cr.item_category IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
               + CASE WHEN cr.primary_reason IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
               + CASE WHEN cr.item_condition IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
               + CASE WHEN cr.min_monthly_returns IS NOT NULL
                           OR cr.max_monthly_returns IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) DESC,
                cr.rule_id ASC
        ) AS rn
    FROM main.returns r
    JOIN main.orders o ON o.txnnum = r.srctxn
    LEFT JOIN main.customers c ON c.profilenum = o.buyerlink
    JOIN main.products p ON p.itemcode = r.itemlink
    LEFT JOIN main.quality_assessment q ON q.inspectref = r.casenum
    JOIN monthly m
        ON m.cust = o.buyerlink
       AND m.mon = substr(r.revdate, 1, 7)
    JOIN main.return_charge_rules cr ON
        (cr.customer_segment IS NULL OR cr.customer_segment = c.seg_category)
        AND (cr.return_channel IS NULL OR cr.return_channel = r.return_channel)
        AND (cr.item_category IS NULL OR cr.item_category = p.itemcategory)
        AND (cr.primary_reason IS NULL OR cr.primary_reason = (r.return_details->>'$.reasoning.primary_reason'))
        AND (cr.item_condition IS NULL OR cr.item_condition = (q.assessment_summary->>'$.condition.item_condition'))
        AND (cr.min_monthly_returns IS NULL OR m.cmrc >= cr.min_monthly_returns)
        AND (cr.max_monthly_returns IS NULL OR m.cmrc <= cr.max_monthly_returns)
    WHERE r.revdate >= '2025-01-01'
      AND r.revdate < '2026-01-01'
)
SELECT ROUND(
    COALESCE(SUM(
        (flat_charge + 10.0 / 100.0 * CAST(unit_value AS DOUBLE))
        - (flat_charge + charge_pct / 100.0 * CAST(unit_value AS DOUBLE))
    ), 0),
    2
) AS rhc_increase
FROM matched
WHERE rn = 1 AND rule_id = 5

       + CASE WHEN cr.item_category IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
       + CASE WHEN cr.primary_reason IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
       + CASE WHEN cr.item_condition IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
       + CASE WHEN cr.min_monthly_returns IS NOT NULL
                   OR cr.max_monthly_returns IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
      ) AS specificity,
      ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
        PARTITION BY r2.casenum
        ORDER BY
          (CASE WHEN cr.customer_segment IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
           + CASE WHEN cr.return_channel IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
           + CASE WHEN cr.item_category IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
           + CASE WHEN cr.primary_reason IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
           + CASE WHEN cr.item_condition IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
           + CASE WHEN cr.min_monthly_returns IS NOT NULL

WITH monthly AS (

    p.itemcategory,

    (q.assessment_summary->>'$.condition.item_condition') AS item_condition,
    m.cmrc
  FROM main.returns r
  JOIN main.orders o ON o.txnnum = r.srctxn
  JOIN main.customers c ON c.profilenum = o.buyerlink
  JOIN main.products p ON p.itemcode = r.itemlink
  LEFT JOIN main.quality_assessment q ON q.inspectref = r.casenum
  JOIN monthly m
    ON m.buyerlink = o.buyerlink
   AND m.return_month = substr(r.revdate, 1, 7)
),
applicable AS (
  SELECT
    b.casenum,
    cr.rule_id,
    cr.flat_charge,
    cr.charge_pct,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
      PARTITION BY b.casenum
      ORDER BY
        (CASE WHEN cr.customer_segment IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
         + CASE WHEN cr.return_channel IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
         + CASE WHEN cr.item_category IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END

         + CASE WHEN cr.min_monthly_returns IS NOT NULL
                  OR cr.max_monthly_returns IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) DESC,
        cr.rule_id ASC
    ) AS rn
  FROM base b
  JOIN main.return_charge_rules cr
    ON (cr.customer_segment IS NULL OR cr.customer_segment = b.seg_category)
   AND (cr.return_channel IS NULL OR cr.return_channel = b.return_channel)
   AND (cr.item_category IS NULL OR cr.item_category = b.itemcategory)

   AND (cr.item_condition IS NULL OR cr.item_condition = b.item_condition)
   AND (cr.min_monthly_returns IS NULL OR b.cmrc >= cr.min_monthly_returns)
   AND (cr.max_monthly_returns IS NULL OR b.cmrc <= cr.max_monthly_returns)
)

WITH return_leakage AS (
    SELECT
        o.buyerlink AS cust,
        substr(r.revdate, 1, 7) AS mon,
        CAST(p.unit_value AS DOUBLE) AS v,
        CAST(p.unit_value AS DOUBLE)
          - CAST(p.unit_value AS DOUBLE)
            * CAST(q.assessment_summary->>'$.results.aesthetic_score' AS DOUBLE) / 10.0
            * CASE (q.assessment_summary->>'$.condition.completeness')
                WHEN 'Complete' THEN 1.00
                WHEN 'Accessories Missing' THEN 0.85
                WHEN 'Missing Parts' THEN 0.60
              END
          + CAST(r.return_details->>'$.shipping.fee' AS DOUBLE) AS rvl
    FROM main.returns r
    JOIN main.orders o ON o.txnnum = r.srctxn
    JOIN main.products p ON p.itemcode = r.itemlink
    JOIN main.quality_assessment q ON q.inspectref = r.casenum
    WHERE substr(r.revdate, 1, 4) = '2025'
),
cm AS (
    SELECT
        cust,
        mon,
        SUM(rvl) AS sum_rvl,
        SUM(rvl) / SUM(v) AS clr
    FROM return_leakage
    GROUP BY cust, mon
),
graded AS (
    SELECT
        sum_rvl,
        CASE
            WHEN clr < 0.55 THEN 'Contained'
            WHEN clr < 0.70 THEN 'Elevated'
            ELSE 'Severe'
        END AS leakage_class
    FROM cm
)
SELECT
    ROUND(
        100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN leakage_class = 'Severe' THEN sum_rvl ELSE 0 END)
        / SUM(sum_rvl),
        2
    ) AS severe_share_pct
FROM graded

Canadian Solar’s July 2019 warranty settlement was **$6,060.52 USD**.

```sql
SELECT ROUND(
         SUM(ws.settle_fee + ws.settle_cover_pct / 100.0 * ws.replcost),
         2
       ) AS settlement_usd
FROM (
  WITH snap AS (
    SELECT
      r.snapkey,
      r.snapts,
      COALESCE(m.makertag, 'Unlisted') AS maker_group,
      m.makertag,
      m.pnlkind,
      a.alrtstate,
      p.warrstate,
      CASE
        WHEN p.cap_mw < 100 THEN 'Small'
        WHEN p.cap_mw < 300 THEN 'Mid'
        WHEN p.cap_mw >= 300 THEN 'Large'
      END AS cap_band,
      COUNT(r.snapkey) OVER (
        PARTITION BY COALESCE(m.makertag, 'Unlisted'),
                     date_trunc('month', r.snapts)
      ) AS claim_volume,
      COALESCE(o.replcost, 0) AS replcost
    FROM main.plant_record r
    JOIN main.plants p ON r.sitetie = p.sitekey
    JOIN main.panel_models m ON p.modhook = m.modkey
    LEFT JOIN main.alert a ON a.snapalrt = r.snapkey
    LEFT JOIN main.operational_metrics o ON o.snapops = r.snapkey
  ),
  tiered AS (
    SELECT
      snap.snapkey,
      snap.snapts,
      snap.maker_group,
      snap.makertag,
      snap.pnlkind,
      snap.alrtstate,
      snap.warrstate,
      snap.cap_band,
      snap.claim_volume,
      snap.replcost,
      CASE
        WHEN snap.claim_volume = 1 THEN 'Single'
        WHEN snap.claim_volume <= 3 THEN 'Moderate'
        ELSE 'Bulk'
      END AS vol_tier
    FROM snap
  ),
  ranked AS (
    SELECT
      t.snapkey,
      w.rule_id,
      w.fixed_fee_usd,
      w.cover_pct,
      ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
        PARTITION BY t.snapkey
        ORDER BY
          (
            CASE WHEN w.maker_tag IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
            + CASE WHEN w.pnl_kind IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
            + CASE WHEN w.alrt_state IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
            + CASE WHEN w.warr_state IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
            + CASE WHEN w.cap_band IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
            + CASE WHEN w.vol_tier IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
          ) DESC,
          w.rule_id
      ) AS rn
    FROM tiered t
    JOIN main.warranty_settle_rules w
      ON (w.maker_tag IS NULL OR w.maker_tag = t.makertag)
     AND (w.pnl_kind IS NULL OR w.pnl_kind = t.pnlkind)
     AND (w.alrt_state IS NULL OR w.alrt_state = t.alrtstate)
     AND (w.warr_state IS NULL OR w.warr_state = t.warrstate)
     AND (w.cap_band IS NULL OR w.cap_band = t.cap_band)
     AND (w.vol_tier IS NULL OR w.vol_tier = t.vol_tier)
  )
  SELECT
    t.snapkey,
    t.snapts,
    t.maker_group,
    t.makertag,
    t.pnlkind,
    t.alrtstate,
    t.warrstate,
    t.cap_band,
    t.claim_volume,
    t.vol_tier,
    t.replcost,
    g.rule_id,
    COALESCE(g.fixed_fee_usd, 300.00) AS settle_fee,
    COALESCE(g.cover_pct, 5.00) AS settle_cover_pct
  FROM tiered t
  LEFT JOIN ranked g ON g.snapkey = t.snapkey AND g.rn = 1
) ws
WHERE ws.maker_group = 'Canadian Solar'
  AND ws.snapts >= TIMESTAMP '2019-07-01'
  AND ws.snapts < TIMESTAMP '2019-08-01';

       ROUND(AVG(ws.settle_fee + ws.settle_cover_pct / 100.0 * ws.replcost), 2) AS avg_settlement_usd
FROM (
  WITH snap AS (
    SELECT r.snapkey, r.snapts,
           COALESCE(m.makertag, 'Unlisted') AS maker_group,
           m.makertag, m.pnlkind, a.alrtstate, p.warrstate,
           CASE
             WHEN p.cap_mw < 100 THEN 'Small'
             WHEN p.cap_mw < 300 THEN 'Mid'
             WHEN p.cap_mw >= 300 THEN 'Large'
           END AS cap_band,
           COUNT(r.snapkey) OVER (
             PARTITION BY COALESCE(m.makertag, 'Unlisted'),
                          date_trunc('month', r.snapts)
           ) AS claim_volume,
           COALESCE(o.replcost, 0) AS replcost
    FROM main.plant_record r
    JOIN main.plants p ON r.sitetie = p.sitekey
    JOIN main.panel_models m ON p.modhook = m.modkey
    LEFT JOIN main.alert a ON a.snapalrt = r.snapkey
    LEFT JOIN main.operational_metrics o ON o.snapops = r.snapkey
  ),
  tiered AS (
    SELECT snap.snapkey, snap.snapts, snap.maker_group, snap.makertag,
           snap.pnlkind, snap.alrtstate, snap.warrstate, snap.cap_band,
           snap.claim_volume, snap.replcost,
           CASE
             WHEN snap.claim_volume = 1 THEN 'Single'
             WHEN snap.claim_volume <= 3 THEN 'Moderate'
             ELSE 'Bulk'
           END AS vol_tier
    FROM snap
  ),
  ranked AS (
    SELECT t.snapkey, w.rule_id, w.fixed_fee_usd, w.cover_pct,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
             PARTITION BY t.snapkey
             ORDER BY
               (CASE WHEN w.maker_tag IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
                + CASE WHEN w.pnl_kind IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
                + CASE WHEN w.alrt_state IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
                + CASE WHEN w.warr_state IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
                + CASE WHEN w.cap_band IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
                + CASE WHEN w.vol_tier IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) DESC,
               w.rule_id
           ) AS rn
    FROM tiered t
    JOIN main.warranty_settle_rules w
      ON (w.maker_tag IS NULL OR w.maker_tag = t.makertag)
     AND (w.pnl_kind IS NULL OR w.pnl_kind = t.pnlkind)
     AND (w.alrt_state IS NULL OR w.alrt_state = t.alrtstate)
     AND (w.warr_state IS NULL OR w.warr_state = t.warrstate)
     AND (w.cap_band IS NULL OR w.cap_band = t.cap_band)
     AND (w.vol_tier IS NULL OR w.vol_tier = t.vol_tier)
  )
  SELECT t.snapkey, t.snapts, t.maker_group, t.makertag, t.pnlkind,
         t.alrtstate, t.warrstate, t.cap_band, t.claim_volume, t.vol_tier,
         t.replcost, g.rule_id,
         COALESCE(g.fixed_fee_usd, 300.00) AS settle_fee,
         COALESCE(g.cover_pct, 5.00) AS settle_cover_pct
  FROM tiered t
  LEFT JOIN ranked g ON g.snapkey = t.snapkey AND g.rn = 1
) ws
WHERE ws.snapts >= DATE '2021-01-01'
  AND ws.snapts < DATE '2022-01-01'
  AND ws.vol_tier IN ('Bulk', 'Single')
GROUP BY ws.vol_tier
ORDER BY CASE ws.vol_tier WHEN 'Bulk' THEN 1 ELSE 2 END

WITH snapshot_values AS (
    SELECT
        pr.snapkey,
        pm.pnlkind,
        DATE_TRUNC('month', pr.snapts) AS snap_month,
        CAST(ep.elec_perf_snapshot->'energy_yield'->>'energy_yield_kwh' AS DOUBLE) AS energy_kwh,
        CAST(ep.elec_perf_snapshot->'energy_yield'->>'availability_pct' AS DOUBLE) AS availability_pct,
        CAST(ep.elec_perf_snapshot->'efficiency'->>'soil_loss_pct' AS DOUBLE) AS soil_loss_pct
    FROM plant_record pr
    JOIN plants p ON p.sitekey = pr.sitetie
    JOIN panel_models pm ON pm.modkey = p.modhook
    JOIN electrical_performance ep ON ep.snaplink = pr.snapkey
    WHERE pr.snapts >= DATE '2021-01-01'
      AND pr.snapts < DATE '2022-01-01'
),
yields AS (
    SELECT
        *,
        energy_kwh / ((availability_pct / 100.0) * (1 - soil_loss_pct / 100.0)) AS potential_kwh
    FROM snapshot_values
),
monthly_ratios AS (
    SELECT
        pnlkind,
        snap_month,
        100.0 * SUM(potential_kwh - energy_kwh) / SUM(potential_kwh) AS loss_ratio
    FROM yields
    GROUP BY pnlkind, snap_month
),
banded AS (
    SELECT
        y.snapkey,
        y.potential_kwh - y.energy_kwh AS loss_kwh,
        CASE
            WHEN m.loss_ratio < 6 THEN 'Low'
            WHEN m.loss_ratio >= 14 THEN 'Severe'
        END AS loss_band
    FROM yields y
    JOIN monthly_ratios m
      ON y.pnlkind = m.pnlkind
     AND y.snap_month = m.snap_month
)
SELECT
    loss_band,
    COUNT(*) AS snapshots,
    ROUND(AVG(loss_kwh), 2) AS avg_loss_kwh
FROM banded
WHERE loss_band IN ('Low', 'Severe')
GROUP BY loss_band
ORDER BY CASE loss_band WHEN 'Severe' THEN 1 ELSE 2 END;

```sql
WITH snapshots_2021 AS (
    SELECT
        r.snapkey,
        m.pnlkind,
        DATE_TRUNC('month', r.snapts) AS snapshot_month,
        (e.elec_perf_snapshot->'energy_yield'->>'energy_yield_kwh')::DOUBLE AS energy_kwh,
        (e.elec_perf_snapshot->'energy_yield'->>'energy_yield_kwh')::DOUBLE
            / NULLIF(
                ((e.elec_perf_snapshot->'energy_yield'->>'availability_pct')::DOUBLE / 100)
                * (1 - (e.elec_perf_snapshot->'efficiency'->>'soil_loss_pct')::DOUBLE / 100),
                0
            ) AS potential_kwh
    FROM main.plant_record r
    JOIN main.plants p ON p.sitekey = r.sitetie
    JOIN main.panel_models m ON m.modkey = p.modhook
    JOIN main.electrical_performance e ON e.snaplink = r.snapkey
    WHERE r.snapts >= TIMESTAMP '2021-01-01'
      AND r.snapts < TIMESTAMP '2022-01-01'
),
technology_months AS (
    SELECT
        pnlkind,
        snapshot_month,
        100.0 * SUM(potential_kwh - energy_kwh)
            / NULLIF(SUM(potential_kwh), 0) AS loss_ratio
    FROM snapshots_2021
    GROUP BY pnlkind, snapshot_month
),
classified AS (
    SELECT
        CASE
            WHEN t.loss_ratio < 6 THEN 'Low'
            WHEN t.loss_ratio < 10 THEN 'Moderate'
            WHEN t.loss_ratio < 14 THEN 'Elevated'
            WHEN t.loss_ratio >= 14 THEN 'Severe'

)

ORDER BY CASE loss_band WHEN 'Severe' THEN 1 ELSE 2 END;

SELECT ROUND(SUM(g.base_hours + g.position_hours * c.headct) / COUNT(*), 2) AS average_case_review_hours
FROM main.cases c
JOIN (
 WITH ca AS (

   CAST(c2.h1bdep AS TEXT) AS h1b_dependent, substr(c2.soccd, 1, 2) AS soc_major_group,
   cw2.wsstate AS worksite_state,
   CASE WHEN v.emcv = 1 THEN '1' WHEN v.emcv BETWEEN 2 AND 4 THEN '2-4' WHEN v.emcv BETWEEN 5 AND 14 THEN '5-14' ELSE '15+' END AS monthly_volume_band
  FROM main.cases c2
  JOIN main.case_worksite cw2 ON cw2.dockkey = c2.filekey
  JOIN main.prevailing_wage pw2 ON pw2.trackno = cw2.wagetrack
  JOIN (
   SELECT homefirm, date_trunc('month', strptime(beginday, '%d/%m/%Y')) AS start_month, COUNT(*) AS emcv
   FROM main.cases
   GROUP BY 1, 2
  ) v ON v.homefirm = c2.homefirm
     AND v.start_month = date_trunc('month', strptime(c2.beginday, '%d/%m/%Y'))
 )

  AND (r.monthly_volume_band IS NULL OR r.monthly_volume_band = ca.monthly_volume_band)
 QUALIFY row_number() OVER (
  PARTITION BY ca.filekey
  ORDER BY
   (CASE WHEN r.visa_class IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
    + CASE WHEN r.wage_level IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
    + CASE WHEN r.h1b_dependent IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
    + CASE WHEN r.soc_major_group IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
    + CASE WHEN r.worksite_state IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
    + CASE WHEN r.monthly_volume_band IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) DESC,
   r.rule_id ASC

            PARTITION BY c.homefirm, substr(c.beginday, 4, 7)
        ) AS employer_monthly_volume
    FROM cases c
    JOIN case_worksite cw ON cw.dockkey = c.filekey
    JOIN prevailing_wage pw ON pw.trackno = cw.wagetrack

banded AS (
    SELECT *,
        CASE
            WHEN employer_monthly_volume = 1 THEN '1'
            WHEN employer_monthly_volume BETWEEN 2 AND 4 THEN '2-4'

            ELSE '15+'
        END AS monthly_volume_band
    FROM case_info
    WHERE start_month = '12/2023'
),
ranked AS (

        b.filekey,
        b.headct,
        r.base_hours,
        r.position_hours,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            PARTITION BY b.filekey
            ORDER BY

              + (r.wage_level IS NOT NULL)::int
              + (r.h1b_dependent IS NOT NULL)::int
              + (r.soc_major_group IS NOT NULL)::int
              + (r.worksite_state IS NOT NULL)::int
              + (r.monthly_volume_band IS NOT NULL)::int DESC,

    FROM banded b

SELECT COUNT(*) AS case_count

SELECT
    rule_id,
    ROUND(base_hours + position_hours * headct, 2) AS hours
FROM ranked
WHERE rn = 1;
